name: Rizuhble's One Shot Grey Talon
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-5,600 (levels 1-11). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Guided Owl unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Improved Spirit. Ultimate (Guided Owl) is available from Compress Cooldown.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Charged Shot (2 to 3).

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Improved Spirit completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Recharging Rush, 14400 souls (~14.4 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 10 to Charged Shot's damage (1.00x scaling).
items.why: imminent: Improved Spirit completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Charged Shot: takes 18% off its 17s base cooldown.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. +18 spirit adds about 18 to Charged Shot's damage (1.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 5,600-15,200 (levels 11-22). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Charged Shot T3, Guided Owl T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Charged Shot, damage) grows from 213 to 341. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery.

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Charged Shot (335) clears its 165-damage trigger; Spirit Snare stays under it. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Long Range
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Recharging Rush completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Recharging Rush completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Recharging Rush completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Long Range, High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Recharging Rush completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 15,200-19,200 (levels 22-25). 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Recharging Rush.

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell it for a second counter.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Charged Shot (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 19,200-48,000 (levels 25-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rain of Arrows T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Charged Shot, damage) grows from 379 to 642.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Imbued on Charged Shot: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +56 on its damage (2.00x scaling). Takes spirit from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 60 to Charged Shot's damage (2.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 129s; 20% off is 25.8s per full rotation.

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 38 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.
sections.desc: Dying after Tankbuster? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Charged Shot (channelled) and Rain of Arrows (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep cancelling your charged shot.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Enchanter's Emblem for this, or Stamina Mastery if it's gone.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Charged Shot: resets its 17s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Rapid Recharge: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Charged Shot. Sell Rapid Recharge for this.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 129s of base cooldown across your kit, 85s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Stamina Mastery: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
